educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: FEEDBACK & ERROR
missions.concept: Negative feedback acts on measured error; too little authority leaves error, while excessive gain plus delay can create overshoot or instability.
missions.scenario: Disturbance and loop delay are system conditions. Tune gain and damping.
missions.goalText: Reduce disturbance error without consuming stability margin.

disturbance.label: DELAY INCREASES — NOMINAL TUNE LOSES MARGIN

missions.transferText: The longer loop delay invalidates the nominal tune. Retune gain/damping until tracking and stability are both recovered.

missions.title: PID & IMPEDANCE
missions.concept: Position accuracy and compliant contact are different objectives; stiffness and damping determine how aggressively a virtual spring-damper reacts to contact.
missions.scenario: The contact error is imposed by the environment. Tune virtual stiffness and damping.
missions.goalText: Create useful tracking authority while keeping contact compliant and damped.
missions.transferText: Reduce contact severity after the environment becomes less tolerant.

missions.title: BANDWIDTH, LATENCY & SATURATION
missions.concept: Bandwidth is bounded by plant dynamics, sampling and delay; saturation removes control authority and invalidates the assumed linear response.
missions.scenario: Loop delay is measured. Choose requested motion frequency and command demand.
missions.goalText: Stay inside phase, saturation and bandwidth limits.
missions.transferText: Adapt requested motion and demand after timing degrades.

missions.title: NESTED LOOPS & REAL TIME
missions.concept: Fast inner loops stabilize local physics while slower loops plan; real-time correctness requires bounded deadlines, not merely a high average frequency.
missions.scenario: Worst-case jitter is measured by the scheduler. Choose inner/outer loop rates.
missions.goalText: Maintain loop separation and positive worst-case deadline margin.
missions.transferText: Reduce outer-loop timing pressure or restore scheduling margin.

missions.title: WATCHDOGS & AI AUTHORITY
missions.concept: Learned autonomy may propose behavior, but deterministic limits, timeouts and independent safety supervision must bound its authority.
missions.scenario: AI confidence, command age and safety margin are evidence. You decide whether to execute, filter or fall back.

metrics.label: AUTHORITY CORRECT
metrics.expr: ((confidence>0.65 && age<250 && safety>0.35 && authority=="EXECUTE") || (!(confidence>0.65 && age<250 && safety>0.35) && authority!="EXECUTE"))?1:0

missions.goalText: Execute only when the proposal is fresh, confident and independently safe.
missions.transferText: Trigger a bounded fallback rather than executing stale policy output.

missions.title: CONTROL GATE
missions.concept: Demonstrate feedback tuning, delay awareness and bounded AI authority.
missions.scenario: Each case imposes a different delay or AI state. You tune gain and authority; you do not edit the evidence.
missions.goalText: Complete the three control gate cases.

gateCases.name: TRACKING
gateCases.text: Residual error <3° while phase proxy stays <4.

gateCases.name: DELAY EVENT
gateCases.text: With the imposed delay, preserve at least 1 unit of stability margin.

gateCases.name: AI BOUNDARY
gateCases.text: The AI command is stale. Select safe fallback.
